dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: There are challenges here that should be taken quite seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: After all, aside from myself, all the other Hexenzirkel mages are not only powerful, but highly capricious. Even if I can pass my own tests with ease, those of the others still require my undivided attention.

dialogues.speaker: Nicole
dialogues.text: You know what they're like by now...
